title: Atila iAMP COVID-19 Detection Kit - Saliva (Pt.2)
author: Opentrons
materials: Solution is mixed for one repetition, 12ul.

steps.title: Transfer SRM and saliva to 384‑well plate
steps.instruction: Load up to four source plates onto the instrument and transfer SRM and saliva sample to a 384‑well plate with one mixing repetition. If fewer than four full plates are used, still add SRM to the last two wells (controls). Positive and negative controls will be added manually after the protocol into the final two wells. Set the following parameters before starting: Number of Samples (samples per plate), Reaction plate (non‑skirted or half‑skirted on slot 9; slot 8 always non‑skirted), and P20 Pipette Mount (left or right).

substeps.instruction: Configure instrument parameters: Number of Samples, Reaction plate type, and P20 Pipette Mount.
Load up to four source plates onto the deck.
Transfer SRM and saliva to the designated wells of the 384‑well plate, ensuring SRM is placed in the last two wells when fewer than four plates are used.

steps.title: Add SRM to each well
steps.instruction: Dispense 13 µL of SRM into every well that will receive a sample or control.

steps.title: Add sample to SRM wells
steps.instruction: Add 2 µL of each saliva sample to the corresponding wells containing SRM.

steps.title: Mix the reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Mix the 12 µL solution in each well once (single mixing repetition).
